purpose: Prevent technically-passing but low-quality implementation from being VERIFIED.
reviewer_rule: All required review checks must be PASS and blocking_findings must be empty before a Task can be VERIFIED/CLOSED.
performance_rule: Reviewer must judge code in execution context (build-time/request-time/hot-path/UI-interaction). Avoid avoidable repeated scans, nested loops, repeated parse/serialize/hash, unbounded loops/recursion, and unnecessary large-object cloning. Quantitative benchmark is required only when a locked contract or Task explicitly defines a budget.
